capabilities: Add any command, including community plugin commands, to the note right-click menu
Hide commands by name from all context menus across Obsidian
Assign icons from Obsidian's internal icons and Lucide icons to registered commands
Reassign icons for commands that already have one
disambiguation: Not a general interface editor; adding commands works only on the note menu in Source and Live Preview mode, not Preview mode or the sidebars.
extras: The author describes the plugin as semi-abandoned and points users to Obsidian Commander. Hidden menu items can be styled via the div.custom-menu-hide-item selector instead of being removed. Hiding a command removes all instances of that command name across all context menus, which cannot be scoped to one menu.
intentEvidence: This plugin was initially a fork of phibr0's excellent customizable sidebar
problem: Obsidian's right-click menu has a fixed set of items and offers no way to add your own commands or remove unwanted ones.

relations.evidence: This plugin was initially a fork of phibr0's excellent customizable sidebar
The code for hiding menu items comes in part from Panossa's Mindful Obsidian

summary: Right-click menu customizer that adds or hides commands, including community plugin commands, and assigns custom icons to them.
